fb-guard regularly checks your FRITZ!Box: fb-guard regularly checks your FRITZ!Box for failed logins, open ports, outdated firmware and weak settings, and tells you via Telegram or e-mail.
It only reads. It does not change anythi: It only reads. It does not change anything on the box and only talks to your own box. External services stay off unless you switch them on.
Go through the tabs from left to right. Every step has a test button.
Tip: open the ioBroker admin via HTTPS,: Tip: open the ioBroker admin via HTTPS, then your entries are encrypted on the way to the server as well. The password is stored encrypted.

No guarantee: the adapter helps you spot: No guarantee: the adapter helps you spot problems, but it cannot make your network secure on its own. Use at your own risk.

Open the box in your browser: System > F: Open the box in your browser: System > FRITZ!Box Users > Add User. Name it e.g. "fb-guard", choose a long password and grant only the right "FRITZ!Box Settings". Switch off "Access from the internet".
Also check: Home Network > Network > Net: Also check: Home Network > Network > Network Settings > "Allow access for applications" must be on.
Without encryption the password crosses: Without encryption the password crosses your network in an attackable form. Only switch off if the box cannot do it.
Only do this if you reset or updated the: Only do this if you reset or updated the box.

Caution: many phones, tablets and laptop: Caution: many phones, tablets and laptops use private, changing addresses. After a change they look like a new device to the box. Mainly iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac ("Private Wi-Fi address"), Android 10 and later ("Randomized MAC"), Windows 10/11 ("Random hardware addresses") and Chromebooks.

Some findings can be intended, e.g. a po: Some findings can be intended, e.g. a port forwarding you set up yourself. Confirmed findings are no longer reported and move to the end of the list above. If something changes about them, you get notified again.
1. Click \"Fetch findings into the table: 1. Click "Fetch findings into the table". 2. Tick what is intended. 3. Click "Save" at the bottom. Only then the confirmation counts.
For scripts and VIS the same data is in: For scripts and VIS the same data is in the states of this instance, e.g. "summary.score" and "summary.text". Every state has a description.
Reads all relevant values once and store: Reads all relevant values once and stores them in "info.diagnostics". Passwords, keys, user names, addresses and serial numbers are masked as far as possible. Useful for bug reports, but read it before you share it. The result is shown below the button.
